articleTitle: The working characteristics of two-phase heat transfer devices for LED modules
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: To cool the high-power light emitting diode modules (LEDM) in lighting device it is promising to use two-phase heat transfer devices (TPHTD) - thermosyphons (TS) and heat pipes (HP), the equivalent thermal conductivity of which is hundreds of times greater than the thermal conductivity of metals. To this end, it is the most effective to use TPHTD as LED chandelier frame elements. The paper presents the results of experimental studies of thermal resistance and heating zone temperature in the two-phase thermosyphon with a smooth evaporation surface and in the gravitational heat pipe with thread-capillary structure in the evaporation zone, filled with freone 141b, under conditions of condensation zone cooling by natural air convection.

articleTitle: Turbine spirometers metrological support
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This article deals with the description of the device and principle of the turbine spirometer action. Mathematic model of the rotation of the rotor of the measuring turbine is shown. According to the results of the turbine research the method of determine the coefficients of the conversion function is proposed. In this paper experimental studies of the proposed method are conducted. Research results have shown the adequacy of the description of the transformation function and methods for determining the coefficients.

articleTitle: Balancing model of resource blocks allocation in LTE downlink
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The investigation of the balancing model of resource blocks allocation in LTE downlink is presented. The novelty of model is that it can be used to describe the process of resource blocks allocation in LTE downlink with regard to user equipment requests priority. The application of the model allows optimizing the process of resource allocation in LTE downlink in order to solve the problem by mixed-integer linear programming. The advantage of the model is that the balancing of resource blocks number allocated to each of user equipment is performed on the basis of QoS requirements: the demanded bit rate, the priority and resource type (with or without guarantee). The results of research confirmed the efficiency of model and adequacy of solutions obtained on its basis.

articleTitle: Improved porous silicon-based multifunctional materials for the solar cells antireflection coating
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The paper describes perspectiveness of preparing an antireflective coating by the porous silicon (PS) electrochemical and chemical methods to obtain multifunctional frontal layer for photovoltaic converters (PVC) with improved parameters. Application of the silicon-based column-like and drop-like textures as an efficient and commercially viable coating has to be maximally adapted to processes of the silicon solar cell manufacturing. Described are results of the static etching of the substrate frontal surfaces of a number of samples to determine superficial amount of hydrogen by mass-spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Fast lossy compression algorithm for medical images
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The authors propose a fast lossy compression algorithm for medical image compression. This algorithm has been designed taking into account the peculiarities of medical images. The uniform distribution of errors is applied. A comparative analysis of the proposed algorithm with known compression algorithms which use the wavelet transform is performed. The simulation results confirm the high efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Power quality improvement in single-phase power supplies for resistance welding
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The investigation of input current quality of power supply for resistance welding with direct power consumption for the cases without the power factor corrector (PFC) and with PFC was carried out. Different control methods (borderline, peak current and average current) of active power factor corrector were analyzed and compared by simulation in MATLAB/ Simulink. The circuit of the corrector with minimal electromagnetic impact on power supply was selected. The total harmonic distortion of the circuit input current was assessed and the effectiveness of the suggested solutions was confirmed.

articleTitle: Thermal performance of aluminium grooved heat pipes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Aluminium grooved heat pipes (AGHP) applied for space craft's thermal control systems are considered in the report. Inside AGHPs capillary structures have been optimized in order to make maximum capillary head at minimal hydrodynamic resistance taking into account technological ability of their manufacture. Experimental results of the thermal performances (thermal resistance and maximum heat transfer capability) of AGHPs' filled with ammonia are presented. Results of thermal engineering tests of AGHPs, that have been developed by the order of National Space Agency of Ukraine for “Lybyd”, “AMPOS-SM-KF”, “Cyclon-4” space crafts, and also within Russian space projects, are given in the report.

articleTitle: Investigation of multipath QoS-routing dynamic tensor model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The investigation of the multipath QoS-routing dynamic tensor model with quality of service guarantees over the multiple metrics is presented. The expression for modeling state of the network router interface is used for representing the average packet delay as time-varying function. The conditions of ensuring QoS for the set of metrics as the packet rate and average delay are expressed. The novelty of the model is that the network metric is a function of time, and it takes into account that the average queue length and average packet delay take their limit values after convergence time. The results of the research demonstrated that the use of the dynamic tensor model allows ensuring QoS requirements more precisely.

articleTitle: System for characterization of supercapacitors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The hardware and software system, based on LabVIEW package, for electrical investigations of supercapacitors was developed. The system provides standard testing (cyclic voltammetry, constant current charge and discharge, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, etc.) of supercapacitors in the temperature range of 30 to 100° C and under pressure up to 3 bars. The effectiveness of the system was verified.

articleTitle: Searching similar entities in models of various subject domains based on the analysis of their tuples
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This paper discusses methods to build SD models. One of such methods is constructing data domain models to meet the requirements of each individual user of the system, combining which we obtain a common conceptual system diagram. Detection of such objects in different object domains allows avoiding redundancy and inconsistency of data. The objects are suggested to be compared on the basis of the analysis of the number of connections and characteristics of the properties of objects. Methods for comparing the properties of objects differ depending on the type of scales in which their values are measured.

articleTitle: Research of energy characteristics of QAM modulation techniques for modern broadband radio systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The paper deals with research of energy characteristics of multilevel modulation techniques for modern broadband radio systems. The problems of modeling and analysis of digital data transmission channel are considered.

articleTitle: Production subject domains
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: This article introduces the notion of production subject domains and their state, defines operations on those states. The states on the sets are introduced, in particular on the sets of objects, connections, mass problems. Classification of mass problems is introduced. The notion of markers of change is introduced with the operations on them. The properties of those operations are determined. The technology of application of the described models is defined.

articleTitle: Express-analysis of stability of fourth order frequency-dependent rearrangeable components
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The authors carry out a real time stability analysis of fourth order frequency-dependent components of the specialized computer systems used on autonomous mobile platforms with parameters reconfigurable depending on the environment conditions.

articleTitle: Reliability of multicell-type transistor converter for micro resistance welding
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The analysis of transistor converter with modular structure for micro resistance welding in terms of its operational reliability was carried out, and the particularities, which have crucial importance for ensuring its reliable operation, were found out. The indexes of the converter's operational reliability were assessed. The measures for improving reliability were proposed and their advisability was substantiated.

articleTitle: Properties of SiGe microcrystals in strong magnetic fields for thermoelectric sensors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Studies of the effects of strain and elemental composition on thermoelectric properties of SiGe microwires for sensor applications at the influence of strong magnetic fields have been performed. Magnetoresistance of compressed samples was substantially suppressed in comparison with their unstrained counterparts. The Seebeck coefficient for both kinds of SiGe wires remained weakly dependent on magnetic field intensity. Magnetic effects on transport properties of SiGe promoted with increase of Ge content in solid solution. Assessments of applicability of the developed thermoelectric sensors of temperature at strong magnetic fields were performed.

articleTitle: Electron irradiation effect on resistance of SOI structures
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The radiation resistance of silicon-on-insulator structures has been studied at low temperatures. High-energy electron irradiation (10 MeV, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>) caused a substantial change of resistance of polycrystalline silicon in SOI. Physical reasons for the observed changes have been discussed. The radiation-induced impurity segregation is likely responsible for the appearance of percolation type charge carrier transport in poly-Si layer of SOI at cryogenic temperatures. The measuring properties of developed actuators remained almost insensible to the action of radiation with lower electron fluences (~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>).

articleTitle: Production system for express diagnostics of the agriculture and natural resources objects for portable devices
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Expert systems are widely used in agriculture and nature management to provide domain knowledge that increases efficiency in these areas of human activity. Development of modern information technology resulted in innovative approaches for conducting agricultural activities. Architecture of the expert system for portable device for express diagnostic is proposed in this paper. Programming tools of implementation are substantiated. The client application has been developed for the approbation of the proposed architecture and programming tools. The application is designed for the diagnosis of crop pests. The application works on a portable device in standby mode.

articleTitle: Thermal vacuum test of nano-satellite PolyITAN-2-SAU
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The paper presents results of thermal vacuum testing of engineering model of nano-satellite PolyITAN-2-SAU of NTUU “KPI” in a vacuum chamber TVC-0.2. The aim of the test was to check the operation of all nano-satellite systems in the simulated deep space conditions for participation in the international mission QB50. Tests have shown that defined impact of the space factors do not cause any problems in the systems of nano-satellite.

articleTitle: Computer controlled system for thermogravimetric analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The paper gives a brief overview of computer controlled thermogravimetric analysis system. The system consists of a personal computer, software, data acquisition card and interface for the provision of the necessary conditions for the analysis and adaptation of input and output signals. The entire control system, as well as the acquisition, recording and processing of measured data is solved by software. Application is based on programming package LabView.

articleTitle: Mathematical models of information manipulation in the subject field of intellectual production in educational institutions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The requirements of employers to the intellectual produce change every year with the due preference to the improvement of some criteria and the education's quality. Therefore the methods, helping to process this information. Using the domain analysis, modeling, manipulation and function elaboration, it is possible to conduct the information management in certain domains and to improve education.

articleTitle: PWM converter control in mold oscillation waveform formation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In this paper the structure of the PWM converter - linear motor is considered in detail. The substantiations of replacement by the impulse element within the limitations are considered.

articleTitle: Optical properties of ultrathin Au films on lithium niobate substrate
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: We present the first measurements of optical spectra for metal film-charged oxide structure. Gold films of different thickness were deposited by magnetron sputtering method on the surface of lithium niobate crystals. Transmission spectra of lithium niobate-Au structure before and after the structure annealing were measured and compared. The essential differences in spectra were found. Peak positions in absorption spectra for different initial film thicknesses were determined and conclusion about shift of absorption peaks into long wavelength range with film thickness increase is made. The causes of different behavior of curves for equal film thicknesses but oppositely charged surfaces of deposition are discussed.

articleTitle: Gamma sequences based on perfect binary arrays for data stream encryption
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: In the paper the gamma sequences based on perfect binary arrays presented. Such structures can be applied to encryption of big data streams in real time. The designed gamma sequences meet the requirements of FIPS 140-1.

articleTitle: Screening diagnostic system for chronic obstructive pulmonary diseases
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: Preventive screening examinations of the population are one of the most effective ways to prevent COPD today. In this paper the problem of technical support of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease diagnosis is described. Transmit channel data and testing of technical capabilities of NRF24L01-module for implementation in screening diagnostic system are analyzed. The present measurements agree with the following IEEE basic standards: IEEE 802.15 and IEEE 802.15g.

publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Electronics and Information Technology (EIT)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: thermal vacuum test; heat pipes; LED modules; supercapacitors; thermogravimetric analysis; multicell-type transistor converter; PWM converter control; power quality improvement; turbine spirometers; thermoelectric sensors; SOI structures; fourth order frequency-dependent rearrangeable components; and production subject domains.
